title: Convergence is the next engineering outcome; then one useful operational path, a second case, and review findings turned into better engineering
statement: Green results on separate branches do not establish compatibility.
exact_source_excerpt: Final merge approval and developmental composition are separate boundaries.
changed_axis: immediate priority and sequence (CLAUDE.md developmental-inheritance axes). The final intended effect, the completion boundary BODY + ORGANS + MIND and the authority envelope are unchanged.
intended_effect: The compatible open work behaves as one machine on one exact revision before anyone is asked to merge it, and that machine produces a useful result: first for GREG's own development (an intake recommendation an integrator can use), then for a bounded operational case and a second, materially different one, with what transferred measured. Every substantial component inspected is given a disposition that says where its value goes, who consumes it, what behaviour changes and how that is verified. Defects found by review become regression cases and are tracked for recurrence.
executable_interpretation: Agents (1) keep a reversible composed candidate of the compatible heads within development authority, run the checks on that exact revision, and prepare the intake order, dependencies, compatibility changes and evidence for the integrator; composing approves nothing; (2) show on the composed revision the seven behaviours the source lists (a mission through the real entry point; correct outcomes through interruption and restart; capability identity and device revocation; completed work preserved when a dependency fails; uncertainty, timeout, refusal, failure and refutation told apart; an appraisal bound to the closure and evidence it judged; an account of outcome, costs, uncertainty and next step); (3) repair the timeout and closure-appraisal defects found on the integration line; (4) build one bounded operational slice (request, evidence, missing information, eligibility, routing, completion evidence, acceptance, reconciliation, retained learning) on a sandbox case with labelled fixtures, exercise its adverse cases, then run a second materially different case and measure transfer; (5) connect the representation-repair experiment to a real decision in that workflow, with baseline, budget, withheld cases and success conditions declared first, and keep the simpler method where it wins; (6) turn each review finding into a regression or adversarial case, check other consumers of the same contract, and track recurrence, review cost, integration delay and escaped defects; (7) state an access limit exactly (container browser, cloud desktop, the founder's computer, founder-device acceptance are four different things) and attempt the permitted local test before calling a capability unavailable. The source's five answers are applied as engineering recommendations: intake is prepared, not performed; an unreadable receipt stays unknown, is reconciled from available records first and keeps its pending state across restart; the smallest browser implementation that passes the declared requirements is recommended; a rejected answer earns no credit, scoped to that answer, evidence, task conditions and version, with explicit requalification; a late appraisal mismatch is classified as stale, grants nothing, keeps any separately valid refutation, and a fresh appraisal is requested when required.
owner: Alfonso Lopez (founder authority); the integration owner and implementing sessions on board #96
binding_scope: Work selection, composition, verification and reporting on the integration line (#196 and its children) and in the participating organ repositories. Reversible implementation, tests, a candidate branch and draft review only. No merge of a protected or default branch, deployment, spending, publishing, outside contact, live-credential change or activation of a consequential capability.
constitutional_constraints: Chat text is intent evidence, not founder authentication; it authorizes no runtime act
A composed candidate is evidence only: intake stays the integrator's and protected merges keep their existing approval
The five answers in the source are engineering recommendations; any change to constitutional authority keeps its existing decision process

VEPMC = 0 continues to permit developmental engineering; device acceptance, commercial validation and graduation keep their separate requirements; a container, test key or rehearsal moves none of them

A sandbox operational case uses explicit rules and consented, synthetic or otherwise permitted data, labelled as such; actual payments, customer commitments, publishing and outside contact stay behind their existing boundaries
A skill, worker, browser or tool is reported as used only when it was available and its execution was observed
success_evidence: A candidate branch whose first-parent history names each composed head and commit, with the checks run on that exact revision
One test on the composed revision that walks the seven listed behaviours in one mission
An intake package the integrator can use: exact revisions and order, compatibility changes, claims matched to executed evidence, what is unproven

An operational slice with a usable case packet, a justified next action, unresolved facts, an evidence trail and an accounting projection that separates estimates from transactions; then a second case with measured transfer
tests/unit/test_founder_clarification_20261112.py: the message is kept whole with a matching digest, the pinned sentences are in it, and the record has every required ledger field
failure_evidence: A green result on separate branches reported as compatibility
A candidate branch treated as approval of its parts, or used as the base of other work
A capability declared unavailable for want of the founder's computer when a permitted local test was not attempted
A synthetic rehearsal reported as buyer demand, willingness to pay or commercial validation
A review finding left as a comment with no regression case and no check of other consumers
conflicts: The 2026-11-11 directive says "Do not mix unrelated work into #291" and asks for small bounded pull requests; a composed candidate holds many units on one branch. Resolved by the source: the candidate is developmental composition for evidence, separate from merge approval, and each unit keeps its own pull request.

The source's answer on rejected-answer credit asks for explicit requalification; the credit unit's first fix-round instruction made a founder rejection impossible to lift. Resolved in favour of the source: a founder-signed act lifts it, a bare unsigned row does not.
next_review_trigger: The founder corrects or replaces this clarification, the integrator takes or declines the candidate's heads, or the second operational case is measured
supersedes: Reading a set of separately green branches as a working machine (evidence discipline only)
